name: protect-main-branch
description: Prevent git operations that would modify the main branch (or configured branches) in Claude Code. Blocks `git commit`, `push`, `merge`, `rebase`, `reset`, `cherry-pick`, `revert`, and `am` on the protected branch(es). Individual subcommands can be opted out via PROTECT_MAIN_BRANCH_ALLOWED_SUBCOMMANDS, or the hook can be turned off entirely for the current scope via PROTECT_MAIN_BRANCH_DISABLE.
